name: Factory License (West Bengal)
description: Occupational health and safety factory license under the Factories Act and West Bengal Factories Rules for premises with 10+ workers using power.

metadata.statutory_fee: ₹2,500 to ₹15,000 depending on worker count and motor HP
required_documents: Form 1 (Application for permission to construct or extend a factory)
Form 2 (Application for registration and grant of licence)
Factory architectural plan and machine layout drawings signed by chartered engineer
Electric power connection sanction letter / load certificate from WBSEDCL / CESC
Land possession deed / registered lease agreement / WBIIDC industrial allotment letter
List of partners / directors with address proofs and contact details
Detailed manufacturing process flowchart with raw material inputs
application_steps: Submit factory building layout plan in Form 1 to Chief Inspector of Factories
Upon plan approval, complete machinery installation and safety guarding
Submit Notice of Occupation in Form 2 at least 15 days prior to commencement of manufacturing
Pay factory license fees online via GRIPS payment portal
Inspector of Factories conducts on-site safety audit
Download digitally signed Factory License from Silpa Sathi
metadata.portal_name: Silpa Sathi - West Bengal Single Window (Factory License)

name: WBPCB Consent to Establish (CTE)
description: Mandatory environmental clearance under Section 25 of Water Act 1974 & Section 21 of Air Act 1981 prior to setting up industrial or food processing machinery in West Bengal.

metadata.statutory_fee: ₹5,000 to ₹50,000 based on gross capital investment in plant & machinery
metadata.validity_period: 7 years for Green category, 5 years for Orange category (up to commercial commissioning)
required_documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR) with process flowchart, water balance, and material balance
Site blueprint showing location of production machinery, wastewater drainage, and stack emission vents
Land ownership / industrial lease deed / WBIIDC plot possession letter
Effluent treatment scheme / soak pit drawing or air pollution control specifications
Gross capital investment certificate from Chartered Accountant (CA certificate)
application_steps: Log in to West Bengal Silpa Sathi / WBPCB EMIS portal
Submit online CTE Form I (Water) and Form I (Air)
Upload project report, site plan, CA investment certificate, and wastewater disposal scheme
Pay statutory consent fee online through GRIPS portal
WBPCB Regional Officer conducts site inspection and reviews siting buffer distances
Apply for Consent to Operate (CTO) after trial run notification prior to commercial dispatch
metadata.portal_name: Silpa Sathi - West Bengal Single Window Portal
